central reference for German media landscape analyses."},{"title":"ARD/ZDF Longitudinal Study: Mass Communication 2010–2015 Trend File","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13012","justification":"Combines several ARD/ZDF mass communication waves including 2010 and 2015, allowing analysis of changes in media use in Germany across the first half of the 2010s."},{"title":"Media Exposure and Political Participation in Germany 2012","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.11721","justification":"Survey focusing on citizens’ exposure to different media and their political participation in Germany around 2012."},{"title":"Digital News Use in Germany 2014","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12077","justification":"Concentrates on online and digital news consumption in Germany in 2014, including use of news websites and social media as news sources."},{"title":"German Youth and Media 2010 (JIM Study – Jugend, Information, (Multi-)Media)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.11451","justification":"Part of the JIM series on youth media use; this wave examines how adolescents in Germany used TV, internet, games, and mobile media around 2010."},{"title":"German Youth and Media 2015 (JIM Study – Jugend, Information, (Multi-)Media)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12571","justification":"JIM 2015 investigates youth media usage habits in Germany, including internet, social networks, and mobile devices in the mid-2010s."}]}
